summary: Possible typosquat of @solana-labs/anchor with unverified bundle behavior
details: Package name `@solana-labs/ancor` is a one-character deletion of the well-known `@solana/web3` and `@coral-xyz/anchor` ecosystem naming, published under a `@solana-labs` scope. The shipped bundles `lib/index.cjs.js` and `lib/index.esm.js` contain the keyword shapes typical of HTTP client + ICMP/ping plumbing (multiple `fetch(` calls, `POST`, `https.get`, `ping`), but full semantic tracing of the bundle did not complete, so it cannot be confirmed from evidence whether the network destinations are attacker-controlled exfiltration endpoints or legitimate Solana RPC/anchor-style endpoints embedded in a vendored bundle. The combination of a name-confusion shape against a major Solana namespace plus opaque minified network-active code warrants human review of the publisher identity and the actual destinations referenced inside the bundle before it is allowed into installer trees.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
